title: Complete Augusta Charter Book
key_finding: Augusta's charter created a reorganized government in Richmond County with both county and municipal powers and states that the sheriff is the chief law-enforcement officer of Richmond County; it also references use of the former Augusta Police Department within the consolidated structure.

title: Augusta-Richmond County Elected/Appointed Officials
key_finding: Augusta-Richmond County lists both the marshal and sheriff as current Augusta-Richmond elected or appointed local offices, confirming that they are distinct offices inside the same consolidated government.

title: Sheriff | Augusta
column7: The sheriff page describes the Richmond County Sheriff's Office as providing law-enforcement services with primary responsibilities including maintaining peace and order, enforcing laws, and investigating crimes.

title: Marshal's Office | Augusta
column7: The marshal page describes a specialized role centered on civil process, ordinance enforcement, court and building security, and airport law-enforcement duties, not a general citywide police role.

title: About | Augusta University Police Department
key_finding: Augusta University Police states that it maintains jurisdiction on all Augusta University property, confirming a separate campus-police overlap layer.

title: Georgia: Guide to 2010 State and Local Census Geography
key_finding: The Census guide says Richmond County is served by the consolidated government of Augusta-Richmond County, Georgia CCDs have no legal function, and balance places represent the portion of consolidated cities outside other incorporated places.

title: 2020 Census PL API - Richmond County Georgia county subdivisions
column7: The official Census API shows Richmond County has four CCDs and that Augusta CCD has population 140467, proving it is only one statistical subdivision rather than the consolidated government.

title: U.S. Census Bureau QuickFacts: Augusta-Richmond County consolidated government (balance) Georgia
key_finding: QuickFacts reports a 2020 population of 202081 for Augusta-Richmond County consolidated government (balance), confirming that the balance place is the near-full Augusta municipal geography.

title: 2020 Census PL API - Georgia consolidated cities
column7: The official Census API lists Augusta-Richmond County consolidated government as a consolidated city with population 206607, confirming the underlying city-county consolidation.

title: 2020 Census Count by Georgia City Population
publisher: Georgia Legislative and Congressional Reapportionment Office
key_finding: Georgia's legislative reapportionment office lists Hephzibah as a separate city in 2020, consistent with Augusta's balance geography existing alongside separate incorporated places.

title: 2024 Crime Statistics Summary
key_finding: GBI explains that county crime totals are compiled from all law-enforcement agencies operating in the county, including sheriff's offices, police departments, campus police, and other agencies, which matches Augusta's layered public-safety structure.
